steps.speaker: Graves
steps.content: Dear guests, thank you for coming.
Graves speaks in a soft, clear voice as she lifts the hem of her dress slightly and performs an elegant curtsy to the bizarre assortment of guests.

steps.speaker: Graves
steps.content: We have received your blessings and you have our most heartfelt gratitude.
You bow too, though not by choice. You glance down at your limbs tightly bound with spider silk... Graves even had the spiders tie it into decorative bows.

steps.speaker: Graves
steps.content: Now, let us welcome our honored officiant to deliver the address!
Delighted and excited, she first arranges a circle of strange bones on the dilapidated table, then produces a small human bust from seemingly nowhere.

The bust is severely damaged, with only half of its head remaining, though traces of its once-elegant features are still visible. Graves places it solemnly at the center of the bone circle, a look of devout reverence spreading across her face.
Clearly, this is the "honored officiant."
The hall falls into silence, with only the occasional rustle of moving spiders echoing through the empty space. Graves smiles at the bust, nodding now and then, as if listening intently.
The scene before you is so unnervingly bizarre it makes your skin crawl. You can't help but wonder if she's engaged in a conversation meant for her ears alone.
After what feels like an eternity, Graves finally turns around to you again.

steps.speaker: Graves
steps.content: Make your vow now, my love. The officiant is waiting.

steps.speaker: Graves
steps.content: It asks if you're willing to take Graves as your partner, for better, for worse, for richer, for poorer, in sickness and in health, in joy and in sadness, to support and cherish her... Do you accept?
The bride's burning gaze fixes on you, as focused and intense as a stage spotlight. Beneath the steps, countless eyes—and grotesque things that only vaguely resemble eyes—lock onto you all at once.

steps.speaker: Graves
steps.content: Say it now. Say you'll spend the rest of your life with me, until the end of time.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I vow...
A Ghost Bride... bound...intruder...marriage pact...
You begin slowly, trying to make your voice sound calm and solemn. As the words leave your lips, familiar yet chilling memories resurface, flashing through your mind.

options: I vow to take Graves to be my partner.

steps.content: Shrouded her chosen in cobwebs... consume concoctions of insect bones...

steps.speaker: Letta
steps.content: I will spend the rest of my life with you...
Transformed into armored statues, forever cursed to adorn the castle's halls....

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...through every trial, every joy, until the end of time.
Those who dare defy her... The bride... deep-seated resentment...

steps.speaker: Graves
steps.content: I accept your vow.

More and more details of the story begin to emerge. Graves, the protagonist of this tale, gazes at you with tender affection, tears glistening in her eyes. She gently cradles your hand and slowly presses it against her chest, the tender gesture carrying an indescribable sense of devotion.

steps.speaker: Graves
steps.content: I, as your wife, shall respect and cherish you. I will spend the rest of my life with you, until the end of time.

steps.speaker: Graves
steps.content: From this day forward, we shall never be apart.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Never apart.
In harmony with her voice, the spiders below begin to chant softly, as if performing an eerie ritual. Thick white mist gradually rises from the floor of the hall, blurring the surroundings.

steps.speaker: Graves
steps.content: Now, let's put on the token of our love.
Graves leans in closer, gently taking out a ring. At the same time, countless spiders surge from all directions like a relentless tide.
Spider silk wraps tightly around your limbs, hoisting your left hand like that of a lifeless marionette. Each strand seems to dig into your resolve, forcing you stiffly toward the ring.
Instead of a gem, an eyeball rests at the center of the ring. Its pitch-black pupil stares fixedly at you, compelling you to hold its gaze.
Formidable curse... destined love...
Never... to be pa—rted...

Around you, the monsters move in perfect unison, their footfalls heavy and synchronized, creating a rhythm that celebrates your union. Yet this "celebration" lacks any warmth, only intensifying the oppressive atmosphere hanging in the air.

steps.speaker: Monsters
steps.content: Congratulations! Congratulations!

The monsters growl in unison, their sounds intertwining with that piercing wail from your dream, making your eardrums throb with pain. Yet amid this intense agony, your palm begins to warm slightly, as if some unseen power within you is resisting instinctively.

steps.speaker: Monsters
steps.content: Never apart! Never apart!
[Shackles Effect]

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: This is—
[Bureau]

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Hecate?

Bureau
Recreation Room
Two hours ago

steps.speaker: Labyrinth
steps.content: Long, long ago, in the far reach of the satellite towns, lay the mysterious Morveth Castle.

steps.speaker: Labyrinth
steps.content: It is, in whispered tales, believed to be haunted by a bride—a Ghost Bride who bound any intruder with a marriage pact.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: What is a marriage pact?

steps.speaker: Labyrinth
steps.content: An extremely perilous hominid relationship, as speculated. The Ghost Bride shrouded her chosen in cobwebs, compelling them to consume concoctions of insect bones. Those who dare defy her were all transformed into armored statues, forever cursed to adorn the castle's halls.

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: I thought this was supposed to be bedtime story sharing, not horror stories!

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: This story came from a picture book that suddenly appeared in the Bureau, right? Where is it now?

steps.speaker: Labyrinth
steps.content: Already handed over to Master.
[End of Flashback]

You stare at the red thorns in your hand, tearing through the air with their twisted, bramble-like shape, glowing with a light that brings you comfort. A flood of information surges into your mind as forgotten memories and senses reawaken. You remember now. This is your—
